A male '''Wookiee''' lived on the [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]] during the early reign of the [[Galactic Empire]]. The Imperials used [[Trandoshan]]s to begin stripping Kashyyyk of its resources, with many of the [[Wookiee sanctuary|sanctuary's]] residents retreating further into the jungle to avoid them.<ref name="Tribe" /> Between [[19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|206}}</ref> this Wookiee remained in the sanctuary with [[Yanna]] and was captured by the Trandoshans, but after the Wookiee [[Jedi]] [[Gungi]] and his allies in [[Clone Force 99]] freed<ref name="Tribe" /> him,<ref name="Tribe AD" /> the Wookiee and two other sanctuary residents bought the liberators back to the sanctuary on [[mylaya]].<ref name="Tribe" />
